summary.name: D-ID Creative Reality Studio
summary.one_liner: D-ID is a digital human platform for creating AI avatar videos from scripts, documents or images, and for deploying real-time interactive avatars via an API.
use_cases: create talking avatar videos from scripts
animate a photo of a face into a video
build interactive avatars for customer engagement
produce multilingual training or explainer videos
add AI presenter videos to PowerPoint or Google Slides
integrate avatar video generation into an app via API
summary.what_it_does: D-ID's Creative Reality Studio is a self-service web and mobile platform for making videos with moving, talking AI avatars. Users can pick a pre-made avatar, upload a facial image, or generate a face with a Stable Diffusion-powered text-to-image portrait tool. The site also describes real-time conversational avatars that can be embedded, plus a developer API that requires an API key and paid credits. Integrations with PowerPoint, Canva and Google Slides are mentioned. Output is MP4, with resolution depending on the presenter and plan.
notable: Real-time streaming avatars and embeddable conversational agents
Text-to-image portrait generator based on Stable Diffusion for creating avatar faces
Integrations with PowerPoint, Canva and Google Slides
Developer API with code sample and 24/7 support for API and studio customers
caveats: API use requires valid account credits
Premium AI Presenters (HQ badge) are not supported on the Lite plan
Video length limited to 5 minutes and image size to 10 MB in Studio and API
Full 1080p output depends on plan; standard presenters output up to 1280x1280
